parcels.field.name: Parcel {teryt}
parcels.search.title: Find a Polish parcel
parcels.search.label: Parcel number
parcels.search.hint: The full number from the land register, for example 302116_5.0008.428/1. In Poland a tap on the map also finds the parcel.
parcels.notFound: No parcel has this number. Check it against your land register extract, including the region code before the dot.
parcels.tap.none: No parcel was found at that spot, so a 4 ha square was added instead.
parcels.tap.error: {source} did not answer, so a 4 ha square was added instead.
parcels.tap.offline: Your browser is offline, so a 4 ha square was added instead. Parcels need a connection.
split.field.name: {name} ({n})
merge.field.name: {a} + {b}
edit.cut.hint: Tap two points. The field is cut along the straight line through them, so you can tap on either side of it.
edit.cut.fail.no-crossing: The line does not cross the field. Draw it across the field.
edit.cut.fail.too-many-crossings: The line crosses the outline more than twice, so there is no single cut. Try a line that crosses it exactly twice.
edit.cut.fail.has-holes: This field has a hole in it and cannot be cut.
edit.cut.fail.no-field: Select a field to cut first.
edit.join.hint: Select two fields that share a border to join them.
edit.join.fail.not-adjacent: These fields do not share a border with the same corners, so they cannot be joined. Neighbouring parcels from the land register can.
edit.join.fail.no-field: One of the fields is gone.
edit.layer.label: Show land register parcels (Poland)
edit.layer.hint: Parcel borders appear from zoom level 17 and their numbers from about 18, so zoom in on the field.
edit.layer.error: The parcel layer did not load. The map and your fields still work.
